covered.rule: 1 ask at most twice; close lark_unreached/lark_unclear
1 never say arrears, overdue, facility, payment
2 third parties: disclose nothing, ask when reachable
2 callbacks next business day 08:30-16:15, strictly after now
2 invalid slot ask once; lark_no_callback / lark_callback
3 why-security question is not a refusal
3 no get_account before all questions pass
4 holidays, Mon-Fri, next/this Friday, missing month/year
5 one attempt: full on deadline, floor if full refused
5 common date clamped to own deadline
6 never ask how much; floor..full inclusive
6 date rules (today ok, roll forward within deadline, vague once)
7 batch read-back, "May I record these promises?"
7 one promise per product; retry once
9 one note per unpromised product, reasons list, none on transfer

fixed: special_cases already_paid, dispute and hardship: ends_call changed from true to false. Rule 8 says to mark the product and continue with the other products. In compile.py, ends_call=false is what moves a multi-product call on to the next product instead of to finalize.
